# Salon Olivia backend (FastAPI)
#
# Generated by actually installing into a clean virtualenv and importing
# every module the codebase uses (app/main.py, app/api/*, app/rag/*) --
# this repo never had a requirements.txt before, so these versions are
# tested working, not guessed. Install with:
#
#   python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Note: app/rag/embeddings.py downloads the
# sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model from Hugging Face on first
# use (app.rag.chain builds the retriever at import time, so this happens
# as soon as app.main is imported, not lazily on first request). That
# needs outbound network access to huggingface.co the first time it runs
# in a given environment; after that it's cached locally.
